rules.text: An empty or stale document lock may be acquired; an active lock held by another holder returns exact error BUSY without mutation.
extend and unlock require both the current holder identity and exact lockId; mismatch returns NOT_OWNER without mutation.
Expiry uses the injected virtual clock. The lock is stale when clock.now() >= expiresAt; extend or unlock of that unreclaimed stale lock returns STALE.
A valid extend sets expiresAt to clock.now()+ttl. A valid unlock removes the lock record completely.
Reclaiming a stale lock creates a fresh lockId. The former lockId cannot mutate the reclaimed active lock, even when the same holder reacquires it.
Trace is append-only and copied on read. Each operation emits exactly one of lock, reclaim, extend, unlock, deny after its decision, in call order.

callableSurface.ownership: The factory owns document lock state, token sequencing and trace; caller owns the read-only virtual clock.

transitions: stale acquire -> active with fresh token
valid renew -> active with new expiry

eventOrdering: one trace event is appended after each decision
failed operations append deny and do not mutate
reclaim replaces stale ownership before reclaim is observed
valid release removes state before release/unlock is observed
abortErrorPrecedence: Expiry is evaluated before holder/lockId validation on the current record. After reclaim, validation applies to the new active holder/lockId, so any former lockId is NOT_OWNER.

identityMutation.inputs: keys, owner identities, tokens and virtual clock are read only
identityMutation.tokens: every successful fresh acquisition/reclaim gets a new token
identityMutation.trace: trace returns a new array with new event objects
